responsibility: Defines the abstract value stack and constant-evaluation API used by the GNU Modula-2 front end to model compile-time values as GCC trees plus front-end metadata. The interface covers pushing and popping typed numeric/set/constructor values, conversions between Modula-2 types, arithmetic/comparison and set operators, constructor and aggregate assembly, constant-evaluation queries, overflow checking, and dependency walking for constructor constituents, making it the main contract between semantic evaluation and GCC tree construction.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of M2ALU: it exports the abstract value handle, stack operations, conversions, operators, constructor/set helpers, and dependency walkers that other compiler phases call. Unlike M2ALU.mod, it does not define the cell representation, free lists, GCC-tree manipulations, or constant-folding implementation behind those services.
